meta.title: Stop making generic AI videos
meta.topic:
Create a high-energy, modern product launch video introducing "Zof Studio" (studio.zoedit.com) — an open-source, AI-directed motion graphics studio built with Remotion.

Visual & Narrative Arc (Fast-paced, 30 seconds):
1. Hook (0-5s): Bold kinetic typography exploding smoothly onto the deep navy canvas: "Stop making generic AI videos." Contrast a dull, repetitive template card that shatters away into clean geometric grid lines.
2. Reveal (5-12s): Introduce the Zof Studio logo and brand identity with crisp 2.5D depth parallax — showing a single prompt transforming into live React & Remotion timeline layers, animated waveforms, and custom vector motion scenes.
3. Key Features Showcase (12-22s): Dynamic split-screen and camera-pan beats highlighting three superpowers:
   - True Creative Variety: Custom-coded motion graphics, charts, and B-Roll scenes instead of rigid templates.
   - Smart Social Safe Zones: A vertical 9:16 phone frame snapping cleanly inside TikTok, Reels, and Shorts safe margins with karaoke word-by-word captions.
   - Studio-Grade Audio: ElevenLabs voiceover synced with subtle, crisp UI sound design.
4. Call to Action (22-30s): Clean, authoritative closing frame featuring "Zof Studio — Free & Open Source", displaying the terminal command `zofstudio` and "Try it at studio.zoedit.com".

Pacing & Motion Rules: Vary layout composition in every single beat (never repeat the same header-plus-card layout twice). Use smooth spring physics, subtle ambient motion, crisp typography hierarchy, and keep all focal elements centered within the safe zone.
